title: ragweed-multiscale-surveillance: code and data sample for the ragweed multi-scale surveillance preprint
description: Original analysis scripts (YOLOv11 training, SAHI inference, cross-domain evaluation, domain-shift embeddings, Sentinel-1/2 PRESTO embeddings, Moran's I/LISA and GWR) and a 32-image annotated sample for the preprint 'From Plant Detection to Satellite Mapping: A Multi-Scale AI Toolkit for Ragweed Surveillance under Climate Change' (bioRxiv, doi:10.64898/2026.09.28.755009). Code licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later; data sample CC BY 4.0.
